main_text.head: XX. EJUSDEM PRUSSIÆ DUCIS ad LEGATUM RESPONSORIA.
main_text.p: LITeras Sync. V. die 25. Januarii Berlini datas, cum iis quæ S. V. nomine Ser. Navarræ Regis cognati nostri charissimi, coram referre nobis debuit ad diem 16. Februarii accepimus, & non sine voluptate legimus, quod ex iis Regis optimi singulare erga rempubl. christianam studium, & erga nos etiam fiduciam, cum summa benevolentia conjunctam, non obscure intelligeremus. Quia

page.notes: The initial L of "Literas" is a large decorated initial, joined to the word as "Literas". The catchword "Quia" stands at the lower right. The text is in roman with italic passages; "Regis optimi" and "rempubl. christianam" are italic. Some ink specks on the scan were ignored.
